p:
우리는 폴란드의 회사로, 자체 개발한 MediaSync 시스템을 기반으로 독립 음악 서비스를 주로 제공하며, SaaS 플랫폼, 오디오 마케팅 및 향 마케팅 솔루션도 함께 제공합니다.
우리의 사업은 유럽 여러 나라에 걸쳐 있으며, 현재 폴란드와 해외의 수천 곳 상업 공간에 음악 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.
2008년 설립 이후 전문 역량을 꾸준히 높이고 사업을 지속적으로 넓혀 왔으며, 점점 더 많은 고객의 신뢰와 인정을 받고 있습니다.

我们是一家来自波兰的公司，依托自主研发的 MediaSync 系统，主要提供独立音乐服务，同时提供 SaaS 平台、音频营销及香氛营销解决方案。
我们的业务遍及欧洲多个国家，目前已为波兰及海外数千个商业场所提供音乐服务。
自 2008 年成立以来，我们不断提升专业能力，持续拓展业务，并赢得了越来越多客户的信赖与认可。
t: APR Media's SaaS platform enables businesses to offer in-store music and audio advertising services to their clients. Create playlists, manage promotional spots and distribute audio across multiple locations from one cloud-based system. Flexible and scalable, it helps service providers grow without investing in costly IT infrastructure.

pr: Software as a Service platform to provide music distribution and audio marketing services

With the SaaS platform, you can provide audio and video content distribution services to your customers. The platform allows for full management of audio and video content, including creating playlists, playing videos, implementing additional elements such as advertising spots, etc. You can expand the system with additional distribution points as your customer's needs grow.

MediaSync App for Windows and Android

As part of the subscription, customers receive the MediaSync application, which is installed on a Windows computer or an Android phone or tablet. This application downloads music from our server and stores it on the hard drive or device memory, allowing music to be played without the need for constant internet access.
